title: Luxottica Retail Australia Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of 16 optical dispensing stores from Merringtons Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition

body_sections.Market definition: Local markets for the retail supply of optical dispensing services and the wholesale supply of prescription frames in Australia were considered.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 8 May 2007, the ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition is unlikely to substantially lessen competition.  Factors informing this conclusion include: - the availability of independent optical dispensing stores for consumers in nearly all of the local areas relevant to the proposed acquisition; - the relatively low barriers to entry and expansion in terms of sunk costs and the availability of retail space in strips or shopping centres; and - the ability of independent stores to purchase supplies from non-Luxottica wholesalers and buying groups.
